_about: Settings of the Web Circuit Viewer page. The viewer itself (../web-circuit-viewer.js) needs none.
_examples: Files offered under the drop zone: a name and the addresses of its board and/or schematic (any site that allows cross-origin reads, GitHub Pages does).
_posterSizes: The size presets of the poster maker (pixels). The one with "default": true is selected first (else the first one). The one with "custom": true has W and H boxes, filled with its width and height.

posterSizes.name: Large
posterSizes.tip: 2860 × 2032 px, for print or sharp zooms

posterSizes.name: Custom
posterSizes.tip: Your own size; starts at the blog poster size, 1430 × 1016 px (A4 landscape)
